description: Team Avalon is all about helping NASA establish a lunar base on the moon, and to do that we are going to create the interface explaining where we can land on the lunar poles. These areas are where water is stored as ice, and serves as a valuable resource for establishing a lunar base. Through a web design that can be useful to people on both the Earth and Moon alike, this project will use the most recent data from NASA as well as AI integration to give detailed descriptions of the lunar surface.
